observation_rule: Current local visibility only; remote survey and expired task reports are not an automatic archive. IDs, order, tick, budgets and resources must match within a paired case.
context_semantics: Fresh stateless request at every decision. No claimed context-loss treatment; reset counters do not measure erased history.

decision_contract.validator: current identity, affordability, availability, busy status and schema only

evaluation_contract.location: evaluator_only; never supplied to policy, validator or executor
evaluation_contract.next_choice_score: Hand-authored counterfactual outcome utility; diagnostic only, not game success
evaluation_contract.task_success: All required milestones AND accepted post-completion decision AND successful terminal record AND no unresolved failure or goal loss
evaluation_contract.legal_inspect_wait_abandon: Executed/evaluated without rejection as a wrong strategy; timeout or unsatisfied objective is a separate outcome
evaluation_contract.memory_truth_labels: Evaluator only; stale memories of the correct schema must not be rejected using oracle truth
